title: Nested use cache can leak across root params when outer finishes before inner publishes dependencies
notes: Trigger: outer public 'use cache' calls inner 'use cache' that reads next/root-params and returns { early, slow }; outer returns early without awaiting slow.
Effect: outer cache entry may be keyed without the root param; a later request for another root-param value reuses that entry.
